note: Level 1, both label levels read in the five .sav files that feed this table (files reused from the batch_647 wallace_2026_certain cache; full sha256 match the sibling records). Code derivation (data/wallace_2026_mindsets.py, interest_org.csv spec: interestwork_MCM -> interest_org for s1a/s1b/s2a/s2b, interest -> interest_org for s2c, no _f flip): a single-item table whose code is a rename of one source column per study, so no item permutation is possible; exempt from Step 5b, no verification files. Scope: NOT wallace_2026_interest (interest1-3, S1c/Study 2, 1 = not at all ... 7 = extremely), which batch_651 shipped and is untouched here. WORDING: S1a and S1b variable labels both read 'I think I would like to work at a place like MCM Consulting.'; S2c reads 'I would be interested in volunteering for the XYZ Organization.' (the 2023 JEP:G supplement prints the same sentence as S2c's 'Key DV'). item_text carries these verbatim, prefixed by study and cov_study and joined by ' | ' (prefixes and separator are IRW's; S1a/S1b share one prefix because their labels are identical). GAP: in S2a (cov_study 5, 214 rows) and S2b (cov_study 6, 340 rows) interestwork_MCM has NO variable label and NO value labels, and neither .sps nor either supplement prints its wording. Evidence on what it asked: pspi0000498 supp Table S13 places S2a/S2b in the 'Volunteer Tutoring Organization' context, its S2a table caption says 'Interest in volunteering for the organization', the S2a/S2b climate labels name 'The XYZ Organization' (0 MCM mentions), and the 2023 supplement calls S2a/S2b direct replications of its Study 2 (= S2c). But the same supplement calls S1a/S1b direct replications of its Study 1 (= S1c), and S1a/S1b's labelled item differs from S1c's three items, so 'direct replication' does not establish identical wording; the S2a/S2b wording was therefore NOT inferred and is left out of item_text, disclosed in public_note. OPTIONS: S1a/S1b/S2c value labels 1='1 - Strongly agree', 7='7 - Strongly disagree', 2-6 carry only their digit; digit prefixes stripped (as in batch_648/650) and 2-6 left blank. S2a/S2b carry no value labels; their direction is corroborated by the authors' own syntax and data rather than labels: in-file interRC == 8 - interestwork_MCM on every row in S2a and S2b (as in S1b and S2c), Study S2a Syntax.sps says 'compute interRC=8-interestwork_MCM.', MergedData.sav pools all five studies' interRC as one outcome with distributions equal to 8 - column in each, and the growth condition (treat=1) has LOWER mean resp than fixed (treat=0) in all five studies (S1a 2.7 vs 3.8, S1b 2.6 vs 3.5, S2a 3.6 vs 4.4, S2b 3.1 vs 3.9, S2c 3.4 vs 4.1), i.e. more agreement with interest under growth, as in every sibling table. (S2b's own .sps returns OSF HTTP 500 on 2026-09-28, as it did for the batch_647 cache.) NO RECODE: live table has no itemcov_recoded column; the script applies no 8 - resp to this spec. Route 9, source = live exactly for all 5 study vectors (resp 1..7): S1a 61/37/39/30/32/28/11, S1b 100/80/53/55/43/37/14, S2a 29/29/29/40/25/30/32, S2b 63/55/54/66/45/26/31, S2c 97/125/136/196/79/71/89 (total 1967 rows). No instructions text in any .sav or .sps; left blank. Rights: study-authored item, no stated restriction located (silence = permission).
public_note: The item was worded for a different organization by study -- working at MCM Consulting in Studies S1a and S1b (cov_study = 2, 3), volunteering for the XYZ Organization in Study S2c (cov_study = 7) -- and its wording in Studies S2a and S2b (cov_study = 5, 6; a volunteer tutoring organization) is not recorded in the source files, so item_text gives only the three documented wordings; responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree (higher = less interest), the opposite direction from wallace_2026_interest, with the S2a/S2b anchors unlabelled in the source and assumed to match.
